periods.label: 以偷袭确认一辉战场之心的钢铁狂熊

status.current: helps Ikki and confirms he remains constantly battle-ready

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Training helper who tests Ikki with an ambush and praises his chance against Stella.
relationships.momiji-asagi: Her exchange with Ikki gives Kaga the opening for his surprise attack.

periods.summary: Kaga joins the pre-final sparring group and, after Momiji's defeat, suddenly attacks Ikki from behind with Armor-Piercing Shot. Ikki calmly redirects the force into the ground and counters. Kaga explains that he wanted to remind Ikki to keep a battlefield heart at all times, then laughs when he realizes Ikki needed no such warning. He concludes Ikki has a chance against Stella because his technique can receive and redirect even monstrous power.

key_events.summary: Ambushes Ikki and validates his constant readiness.
